name: loyola-robots
title: Page not found at /robots.txt
text:
Page not found at /robots.txt Page not found (404) Request Method: GET Request URL: https://www.uloyola.cd/robots.txt Using the URLconf defined in ULC_loyola_core.urls ,
      Django tried these URL patterns, in this order: admin/ __reload__/ [name='home'] cultural_activity/
                [name='activity'] activites/<slug:slug>/
                [name='activity_detail'] bde/
                [name='bde'] academic_secretariat/
                [name='academic_secretariat'] rectorat/
                [name='rectorat'] secretariat_administratif/
                [name='secretariat_administratif'] administractif_du_budget/
                [name='administractif_du_budget'] philosophy_faculty/
                [name='philosophy_faculty'] science_and_technology/
                [name='science_and_technology'] agronomiques_and_veterinaires/
                [name='agronomiques_and_veterinaires'] business_administration/
                [name='business_administration'] social_sciences_and_management/
                [name='social_sciences_and_management'] all_courses_list/
                [name='all_courses_list'] alumnis/
                [name='alumnis'] the_registration
                [name='the_registration'] contact/
                [name='contact'] about/
                [name='about'] teacher_profile_detail/<int:profile_id>/
                [name='teacher_profile_detail'] bibliotheque/
                [name='bibliotheque'] newsletter/subscribe/
                [name='newsletter_subscribe'] newsletter/unsubscribe/<uuid:token>/
                [name='newsletter_unsubscribe'] services/logement-etudiant/
                [name='logement_etudiant'] services/logement-etudiant/<slug:slug>/
                [name='logement_detail'] services/labo/
                [name='labo'] services/service-learning/
                [name='service_learning'] services/service-learning/actualites/<slug:news_slug>/<int:news_id>/
                [name='service_learning_news_detail'] services/service-learning/publication/<slug:slug>/
                [name='service_learning_highlight_detail'] services/language-centre/
                [name='language_centre'] services/language-centre/publication/<slug:slug>/
                [name='language_centre_publication_detail'] nos-besoins/
                [name='nos_besoins'] admission/
                [name='admission'] user/ blog/ teachers_admin/ students_admin/ api/ tinymce/ filer/ ^media/(?P<path>.*)$ The current path, robots.txt ,
        
        didn’t match any of these. You’re seeing this error because you have DEBUG = True in
      your Django settings file. Change that to False , and Django
      will display a standard 404 page.
